urdu transliteration: Shaam ki janib safar hay ya elaahi Khair kar\nSab ki Zainab par Nazar hay ya elaahi Khair kar
english translation text: They journey toward Shaam — O Lord, protect them.\nAll eyes are fixed upon Sayyida Zainab bint Ali — O Lord, protect them.

urdu transliteration: Ye Bhala Kaisi qayamat aa gai hay aey Khuda\nAik neazy pe mery malik Behan ki hay Rida\nAik par Bhai ka sar hay ya elaahi Khair kar
english translation text: What kind of terrible calamity has arrived, O God?\nUpon one spear is my Master's and in another sister's veil.\nUpon another is the brother's head — O Lord, protect them.

urdu transliteration: Wo Jo ik sher tha naamoos o haya ka zaamin\nJo alamdar tha Zainab ki Rida ka zaamin\nWo TU ab khoon may tar hay ya ilaahi Khair kar
english translation text: He who was a lion, guardian of honor and modesty.\nHe who was the standard bearer, protector of Zainab's veil.\nHe now lies drenched in blood — O Lord, protect them.

urdu transliteration: Sar Jo neazon pe Liye aaey sitamgar saary\nIn pe rahon may koi Kash na pathar maary\nIn may asghar ka bhi sar hay ya elaahi Khair kar
english translation text: All the oppressors came carrying heads upon spears.\nWould that no one throws stones at them on the roads.\nAmong them is even Ali al Asghar ibn Hussain's head — O Lord, protect them.

urdu transliteration: Boleen Zainab k bachalo mujhy Amma fizza\nPusht par apni chupalo mujhy Amma fizza\nHar Nazar teer o tabar hay ya elaahi Khair kar
english translation text: Sayyida Zainab bint Ali cried: Save me, Mother Fizza.\nHide me behind your back, Mother Fizza.\nEvery gaze feels like an arrow and an axe — O Lord, protect them.

urdu transliteration: Khaak par jis ne qadam bhi nahi rakha bi bi\nAaj sehti hay aziyat ye sakina bibi\nUs ka panjo'n pe guzar hay ya elaahi Khair kar
english translation text: She who never even placed her feet upon bare earth.\nToday bibi Sakina bint Hussain bears this suffering.\nShe now walks only upon her toes — O Lord, protect them.

urdu transliteration: Wo Jo hota TU sakina ko dilasa deta\nUmme Laila ko Jo rahon may Sahara deta\nUs ka neazy may Jigar hay ya elaahi Khair kar
english translation text: If he were here, he would comfort Sakina.\nHe would support Umm Layla on the road.\nBut his attention and heart is upon a spear — O Lord, protect them.

urdu transliteration: Pusht e naaqa se giri kar k ye naaly Zainab\nKaise Marty huy bacho'n ko bachaly Zainab\nKoi chaara na magar hay ya elaahi Khair kar
english translation text: Falling from the back of the camel, Zainab cries out.\nHow can Zainab save the dying children?\nThere is no remedy left — O Lord, protect them.

urdu transliteration: Gham ye Moshi abhi Zainab ko uthana ho ga\nAik badkaar k darbaar may jana ho ga\nHaeey Yasir ye khabar hay ya elaahi Khair kar
english translation text: This heavy grief o moshi bibi Zainab must still endure.\nShe must now enter the court of a wicked tyrant.\nAlas, Yasir, this is the sorrowful news — O Lord, protect them.
